name: Cross-hatch power fractal (PowerNoiseSuite)
plain: Sums axis-aligned sinusoidal hatch patterns over octaves. The base class then applies color mapping and blur. The angle input is stored but never used. A structured, line-like initial noise rather than a random field.
math: Octave sum of sin(x·f·π) and sin(y·f·π) grids, each min-max scaled and weighted persistence^k; angle unused. Linear variant: f·gain, plus noise·tolerance (latent_noise.py:290,440), then stepped mapping. Normalized to [0,1].
label: from code

audit.note: No rotation. PowerNoiseSuite modules/latent_noise.py:215,373 store angle_radians but nothing uses it, so angle_degrees has no effect and hatches stay axis-aligned (290-291, 435-436). The linear variant also scales frequency by gain, adds randint noise (438-440) and maps to steps (455). Colour mapping and blur are not optional in the base class.
